summary: Build practical real estate valuation and appraisal skills with market, income, and cost methods. Enroll for hands-on templates and report practice.
lede: Real estate appraisal training helps property professionals assess value and prepare supported conclusions. It is intended for people who value property, review appraisal evidence, or use valuation outputs in lending, investment, brokerage, and asset management decisions. Participants practise comparable analysis, apply market, income, and cost approaches, test value sensitivities, and document assumptions in clear valuation reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to value property, review appraisal evidence, or use valuation outputs in lending, investment, brokerage, and asset management decisions.
prerequisites: Participants should bring a calculator, a laptop with spreadsheet software, and familiarity with basic property terminology. A working knowledge of rent, yield, occupancy, and simple financial ratios will make the exercises easier to follow.
